title: The Schwarzian derivative in several complex variables univalence and geometry
summary: In one complex variable the Schwarzian derivative characterizes the Möbius transformations, arises from a second-order linear equation, and controls univalence through the theorems of Nehari and of Ahlfors--Weill. This chapter presents what is known about these three properties for locally biholomorphic mappings in $\mathbb{C}^n$. Starting from Oda's definition we construct a bilinear operator whose norm, taken with respect to the Bergman metric, is invariant under the automorphisms of the ball, and we show that this operator measures the extrinsic curvature of the preimages of hyperplanes.…
